name: multi-select
title: MultiSelect
description: Several choices from a list, typed to filter, on Base UI's Combobox with multiple: each chosen item is a removable chip before the input, with Combobox's popup and items, in three sizes.

manifest.name: multi-select
manifest.title: MultiSelect
manifest.description: Several choices from a list, typed to filter, on Base UI's Combobox with multiple: each chosen item is a removable chip before the input, with Combobox's popup and items, in three sizes.
manifest.usage: Use MultiSelect when the user picks any number of values from a list (columns, privileges, schemas, tags). Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel, pass items and a function child that renders each one as a ComboboxItem, as for Combobox; value is an array. Items that are { value, label } objects show their label on the chip; for ids from a Combobox.createItems collection pass itemToStringLabel. The list stays open after each choice; Backspace in the empty input removes the last chip. With TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onOpenChange (blur on close) to the field. For one value use Combobox or Select; for a few always-visible options, a CheckboxGroup.

props.name: items
props.description: The items to filter and list; the function child renders each one.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the user adds, removes or clears values.

props.name: itemToStringLabel
props.description: A value's text on its chip and in the input; { value, label } objects need none.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder of the input while nothing is chosen.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when no item matches the text.

props.name: status
props.description: A polite live line above the items (loading, an error); nothing when empty.

props.name: size
props.description: Minimum frame height from size.control.*; chips wrap onto more lines.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name of the hidden inputs; a Field's name wins.

props.name: required
props.description: A value must be chosen before the form submits.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignores interaction; a Field's disabled sets it too.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Focusable but the values cannot change.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no FieldLabel.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the frame, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: frame
slots.description: The Input-like frame, role="group"; data-slot="multi-select", data-size and data-popup-open name it.

slots.name: chips
slots.description: The chips and the input, wrapping; data-slot="multi-select-chips".

slots.name: chip
slots.description: One chosen value in color.neutral.subtle, named by its text; data-slot="multi-select-chip" and data-highlighted when reached with ArrowLeft.

slots.name: clear
slots.description: Removes every value, shown while there is one; data-slot="multi-select-clear".

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: The chevron that opens the list, out of the tab order; data-slot="multi-select-trigger".

slots.name: popup
slots.description: Combobox's positioner, popup, status, empty line and list (data-slot="combobox-*").

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus in the input: a ring of ring.width in color.ring around the frame.

states.name: has values
states.description: With chips the frame's start padding drops to space.inline.xs, so the first chip sits close to the border.

states.name: open
states.description: While the popup is open the frame border is color.border.focus.

states.name: entering
states.description: The popup fades in over motion.duration.fast with motion.easing.enter, and out with motion.easing.exit.

states.name: chip highlighted
states.description: The chip reached with ArrowLeft, or the item under the pointer or the keyboard: color.interactive.selected or hover.

states.name: no value
states.description: The clear button is hidden while there is nothing to clear.

states.name: invalid
states.description: In an invalid Field, or with aria-invalid: color.status.danger.border borders.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Ignores interaction, at opacity.disabled; the clear and chip remove buttons are hidden.

accessibility: The input is role="combobox" with aria-autocomplete="list", named by its FieldLabel (aria-labelledby) or aria-label; the popup is a role="listbox" with aria-multiselectable, and chosen items have aria-selected and a check mark.

Typing filters; ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the highlight, Enter adds or removes the highlighted item and the list stays open. Backspace in the empty input removes the last chip; ArrowLeft at the start of the input moves onto the chips, where Backspace or Delete removes one.

Each chip is named by its text and its remove button by removeLabel ("Remove SELECT"); the clear button is named by clearLabel. The chevron is out of the tab order and hidden from assistive technology.
Chips use color.neutral.subtle with color.neutral.subtle-fg (4.5:1), and the highlighted chip color.interactive.selected, with a focus ring as well.
The popup takes the frame's theme and density even when they are set on a region rather than <html>.
